Subject: CAIQ questionnaire and mapping request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Skyline's security team ran the CAIQ and we had a few follow-ups around how certain controls map to your runtime/tenant model. Can you confirm the following before we lock a submission window?

1) Which CAIQ controls cover the KV cache/tenant isolation path when customers use Dedicated vs Hosted? (we flagged some language in A.3 about multi-tenancy)
2) Do you have runtime telemetry samples showing request-level tracing and retention windows (we'd prefer a sample extract rather than a long list)

We're aiming to submit next Wednesday — if you can provide a short control mapping + attachments (anything labelled with control IDs) that would speed things up.

Appreciate it — Claire
Security Programs, Skyline Therapeutics

Subject: CAIQ submission materials: Skyline Therapeutics — control mapping + evidence links

Hi Claire / Avery,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on timing. Per your request, we've prepared a concise CAIQ control crosswalk and an indexed evidence bundle to support your submission. High-level summary below and links to artifacts:

What we delivered:
- redwood_caiq_control_map_v1.xlsx — single-sheet crosswalk mapping CAIQ control IDs to Redwood product features and short rationale (see "isolation_notes" and "keystore_notes").
- evidence_index_preview.pdf — index of artifacts, owners, and timestamps (rotation attestation, telemetry sample meta).
- runtime_tracing_sample_72h.jsonl (secure) — 72-hour redacted telemetry sample (request_id, model_variant, node_region, cache_hit).
- access-instructions.md — instructions for a secure, time-limited retrieval; includes who to contact for elevated access (Priya for keystore, Jordan for telemetry).

Key control answers you flagged:
- Multi-tenancy & isolation (A.3 family): Hosted endpoints rely on logical token scoping + prefix/KV cache namespacing; Dedicated provides physical tenant boundary with reserved GPU pools and VPC routing. Refer to sheet "isolation_notes" in the spreadsheet for language you can paste into your CAIQ answers.
- Encryption & key rotation: Keystore is HSM-backed; rotation attestation and rotation_log_snippet.txt show last rotation cycle and owner contact (Priya Natarajan).
- Observability & tracing (CC7/CMA2): We provided a redacted sample and retention metadata; the sample demonstrates request-level tracing and our default 30-day retention policy.

Links (short preview / download):
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSKYLINE-CAIQ
- DocuSign (if you need an attestation signature): https://docusign.net/envelope/ABCDEF123456

Attachments included as previews: evidence_index_preview.pdf, redwood_caiq_control_map_v1.xlsx (full spreadsheet in folder). If you'd like, we can:
- Join a 30-min review call Monday to walk the tracing sample and the control wording (Jordan + Kimberly on call),
- Produce a signed keystore rotation attestation on company letterhead (if required).

Next steps: tell us which CAIQ sections you want us to populate verbatim and whether Skyline needs parent-level wording vs. implementation notes. We can turn around verbatim responses for a few high-priority controls within 24 hours.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
